edges.reason: numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop in mintDoges.
_price parameter is written into mintPrice by setMintPrice.
_maxValue parameter is written into maxToMint by setMaxToMint.
_to parameter is used as mint recipient in reserveDoges.
_numberOfTokens parameter bounds the reserve loop.
_revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
_provenanceHash is written into PROVENANCE_HASH.
baseURI is forwarded to the internal base URI setter.
_tokenId is passed to the internal _exists check.
mintIndex local is derived from totalSupply inside mintDoges.
balance local is read from the contract balance in withdraw.
walletBalance local is computed inside withdraw.
supply local snapshots totalSupply in reserveDoges.
i local is the loop counter in reserveDoges.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintDoges.
block.timestamp sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in the constructor.
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to set startingIndexBlock.
mintDoges invokes _safeMint which makes an external callback.
_safeMint calls back into the msg.sender recipient via onERC721Received before state is fully settled.
reserveDoges invokes _safeMint, enabling an external callback during minting.
withdraw sends half the balance to wallet1 via transfer.
withdraw sends the remaining balance to wallet2 via transfer.
setStartingIndex derives randomness from blockhash values.
setStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable.
startingIndexBlock is read as the seed in setStartingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock, affecting reveal randomness.
wallet1 is the recipient of the first transfer in withdraw.
wallet2 is the recipient of the second transfer in withdraw.
MAX_DOGE_SUPPLY caps the supply during mintDoges.
mintPrice determines the payment requirement in mintDoges.
maxToMint bounds the number of tokens per mintDoges call.
saleIsActive gate is checked at the start of mintDoges.
mintDoges conditionally writes startingIndexBlock.
constructor initializes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp.
setSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag.
setMintPrice writes the mintPrice state variable.
setMaxToMint writes the maxToMint state variable.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, controlling reveal timing.
setProvenanceHash writes the PROVENANCE_HASH state variable.
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to the owner.
reserveDoges is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to the owner.
